title: The Blinding Vale PUG baseline for +10 to +15

pulls.notes: Take the left opening and use Bloodlust if planned. Focus Lightgorged Lasher shields, assign Radiant Spellsower interrupts, and avoid the Grovekeeper's knockback into nearby packs.
Keep the Sporeblight Belcher isolated from uncontrolled overlaps, stop Light Bolt Volley, and kill shielded Lashers before their nearby healing extends the pull.
Mark separate Spellsower kicks, control runners before they wake dormant Lashers, and reserve a group defensive for the Belcher if casts overlap.
Finish the Grovekeeper and Spellsower cleanly, or deliberately chain the nearby low-health Lashers into the boss only when the group has control and healer resources.
Stack the trio for cleave, interrupt Light Bolt, dodge Lightsower Dash, and move away after Thornblade. Intercept each Lightblossom Beam by standing on its blossom rather than in front of it.
This dense mixed pull is a natural split point for learning groups. Interrupt Disorienting Screech, respect the Saptor frontal, and avoid overlapping Belcher pressure with Grovekeeper disruption.
Stack root spawns tightly enough to cleave without overlapping circles, break rooted players immediately, and have the Bloodthirsty Gaze target kite Ikuzz through existing root clusters.
Split the bridge while learning. Assign the Petalwing interrupt, dodge both Saptor frontals, stop the Grovecrawler, and dispel dangerous magic effects before they compound.
Keep the Saptor faced away, assign Grovecrawler stops, and use the cleared bridge space rather than drifting toward adjacent enemies.

Resolve the encoded trash before or with Ruia only if the group is prepared. Spread Lightfire, point locked Pulverizing Strikes cones away and then stand still, heal Grievous Thrash targets to full, and save major cooldowns for the final phase.
Mark each Petalwing interrupt, keep the Matriarch facing cleared ground for Tongue Toss, remove poison quickly, and prioritize shielded Lashers without stacking avoidable casts.

The source recommends splitting this platform into two or three pulls for PUG safety. Interrupt the spread casters immediately, focus Lasher shields, and avoid combining Belcher pressure with the Hydra unless cooldowns are ready.

Group and kill Lightspawn Lashers, assign healthy players to intercept every Essence orb, and aim Concentrated Lightbeam through all dormant corpses while placing the resulting hazards away from future movement.

provenance.description: Original WHELP transcription and normalization of Skandar Tank Blinding Vale revision 2. Keystone.guru flags the route as using an older mapping; its non-empty source pulls recompute against current MDT values to the rendered 697/686 enemy forces (101.6%).

The public MDT2 export contains fourteen pull slots, but slot thirteen is empty and the route listing reports thirteen pulls. WHELP omits that empty slot, preserves every non-empty enemy selection, and leaves the route draft because the author also warns that the displayed count is incorrect.
Pull notes and boss tactics are original compact summaries corroborated against Wowhead's updated Patch 12.1 Blinding Vale overview.
Current NPC identifiers, encounters, clone availability, and per-unit enemy-forces values reconciled against Mythic Dungeon Tools 6.2.10 and DBM Dungeons r261 Retail data.
